frameworkContext: React 19 / Vite 8 / Tailwind CSS 4 / Koupreng Design Tokens

libraries.name: Animate UI
libraries.patternEvaluated: Step transitions, inline status pills, accordions
libraries.currentKouprengPrimitive: Native CSS keyframes (@keyframes fadeInStep) and transition tokens
libraries.justification: Commons Clause forbids source redistribution into customer-exportable invitation templates. Koupreng implemented original hardware-accelerated CSS step transitions (250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) without adding extra runtime dependencies or license risk.
libraries.riskAssessment: Zero runtime overhead; no license conflict

libraries.name: Badtz UI
libraries.patternEvaluated: Event type selection cards and tactile celebration badges
libraries.currentKouprengPrimitive: Event type buttons (.event-type-option) with Lucide SVG icons
libraries.justification: Badtz UI restricts commercial redistribution. Koupreng designed original, accessible selection cards with 44px+ tap targets, aria-pressed semantics, and gold-honed hover states.
libraries.riskAssessment: Full license compliance; accessible native buttons

libraries.name: Lightswind UI
libraries.license: Conflicting site terms vs MIT repo
libraries.patternEvaluated: Tonal surfaces, warm cream elevations, gentle border treatments
libraries.justification: Site terms restrict builders and redistribution. Koupreng uses its own Cambodian ceremonial palette (ivory #fcfbf9, cream #ffffff, soft bronze #967037) natively via CSS custom properties.
libraries.riskAssessment: No third-party code copied; pure native tokens

libraries.name: Kokonut UI
libraries.patternEvaluated: Media upload dropzone, focal alignment selector, status feedback
libraries.currentKouprengPrimitive: EventPhotoUpload.jsx with drag-drop and focal point selectors
libraries.justification: Kokonut UI patterns informed the clean, compact upload card hierarchy and focal buttons in EventPhotoUpload. Free MIT subset principles applied locally without importing unvetted packages.
libraries.riskAssessment: Clean native React 19 implementation with URL.createObjectURL revocation

libraries.name: Untitled UI
libraries.patternEvaluated: Field hints, structured review grid, validation error placement, stepper semantics
libraries.currentKouprengPrimitive: EventFields.jsx, EventCreatePage.jsx review card, EmptyState.jsx vendor primitive
libraries.justification: Untitled UI patterns for form validation, field hints, and empty states are reused in Koupreng's shared architecture. Review step groups fields by task (People, Date/Time, Location) following Untitled UI UX standards.
libraries.riskAssessment: WCAG 2.2 AA compliant labels, aria-describedby linkage, aria-invalid attributes

libraries.name: shadcn/ui
libraries.patternEvaluated: Progress bar, dialogs, button variants, preference disclosure
libraries.currentKouprengPrimitive: Native HTML elements with Tailwind 4 styling and shared Accordion/Modal
libraries.justification: Koupreng adapts shadcn/ui design tokens and component styling directly into native JSX/Tailwind primitives, avoiding bloated Radix runtime dependencies.
libraries.riskAssessment: Minimal payload, robust focus visible outlines

libraries.name: React Bits
libraries.patternEvaluated: Gentle skeleton loading, subtle reveal effects
libraries.justification: React Bits inspiration is implemented via pure CSS pulse animations without GSAP or Canvas overhead, preserving light payload and instant reduced-motion fallback.
libraries.riskAssessment: Zero JS bundle weight; instant disable under prefers-reduced-motion

libraries.name: Aceternity UI
libraries.patternEvaluated: Card elevation, depth cues, badge pills
libraries.justification: Aceternity custom license strictly prohibits template and marketplace redistribution. Koupreng uses original CSS box-shadows and subtle gold borders.

libraries.name: Magic UI
libraries.justification: Magic UI metric cues informed QuotaProgress. Stepper progress bar uses native CSS width transitions with accurate aria-valuenow attributes.
libraries.riskAssessment: Truthful DOM feedback without artificial timers

libraries.name: Skiper UI
libraries.currentKouprengPrimitive: Native mobile bar with flexbox and safe-area-inset padding
libraries.justification: Skiper UI mobile navigation concepts inspired Koupreng's persistent mobile bottom bar. Built with native CSS, safe-area-inset-bottom support, and 44px touch targets.
libraries.riskAssessment: Fully responsive across iOS/Android viewports without external JS
